note: v3 beat list. Each beat: one VO clip; acts are anchored to words (w). kind act = the board changes (capture is time-warped so it lands on the word); hl = a spotlight/callout on the word; tile = one tile of a montage grid; text = kinetic text on the stage (hook); phone/chip = overlays.

beats.title: 8:30 am
beats.vo: It's eight thirty. Thirty students are waiting, and the teacher has a dozen jobs to do before she can even start.
What if the board did the busywork, so she could just teach?

acts.text: What if the board did the busywork?

beats.vo: Meet ZYNETIX Board, the AI smartboard.

beats.title: One lesson, start to finish
beats.vo: Let's follow Ms Kavya through one science lesson, from the first minute to the bell.

beats.title: Scan to sign in
beats.vo: She signs in by scanning a code with her phone. No password on a big screen.

beats.title: Or type 6 digits
beats.vo: Or she can type the six digit code instead.

beats.title: Works offline
beats.vo: No internet? The board shows a backup code that works offline.

beats.title: Personal PIN
beats.vo: She can set her own PIN for this board, too.

beats.title: Shuffled keypad
beats.vo: When the board locks, the keys shuffle, so nobody can copy her PIN.

beats.title: Knows your class
beats.vo: The board already knows her class, Class 10 B science, from the timetable.

beats.title: Concept videos
beats.vo: It suggests short concept videos for today, in English, Hindi and Kannada.

beats.title: Today's plan
beats.vo: Today's plan shows the lesson step by step, with a timer to keep pace.

beats.title: Books & syllabus
beats.vo: Books shows which chapters the class has already covered.

beats.title: Everything one tap away
beats.vo: Her saved boards, recordings and training are one tap away.

beats.title: Pick your pen
beats.vo: Pick a pen, a colour and a thickness.

beats.title: Just write
beats.vo: Then just write. The ink keeps up with her hand.

beats.title: Perfect shapes
beats.vo: Shapes come out straight and clean. Here, a glass slab.

beats.title: Lines and arrows
beats.vo: A line for the normal, and arrows for the light rays.

beats.title: Labels by hand
beats.vo: She labels it by hand: air, and glass.

beats.title: Highlighter
beats.vo: The highlighter marks the title, without hiding the ink.

beats.title: Erase
beats.vo: A mistake? The eraser wipes it away.

beats.title: Undo
beats.vo: And undo brings it right back.

beats.title: Lasso to move
beats.vo: Draw a lasso around anything to move it.

beats.title: Geometry tools
beats.vo: A ruler, a protractor and a compass are built in.

beats.title: AI pen
beats.vo: With the AI pen, her handwriting turns into neat, typed text.

beats.title: Shape AI
beats.vo: And Shape AI turns a wobbly circle into a perfect one.

beats.title: Typeset equations
beats.vo: Equations look just like the textbook.

beats.title: Math solver
beats.vo: The math solver shows every step, even offline.

beats.title: Tools for every subject
beats.vo: The tools drawer has tools for science. For maths. And for computer science.

beats.title: Add a page
beats.vo: Need more space? Add a page.

beats.title: Page overview
beats.vo: See every page at once, and jump to any of them.

beats.title: Backgrounds
beats.vo: Change the background: lines, a grid, or a chalkboard.

beats.title: Share the board
beats.vo: Then share the whole board with students, on WhatsApp or by email.

beats.title: 3D models
beats.vo: Open a 3D model, and turn it with the stylus.

beats.title: Virtual labs
beats.vo: In the virtual lab, move the light ray and watch it bend.

beats.title: Simulations & videos
beats.vo: PhET simulations run even offline. Animations explain each idea. Concept videos help with revision. And the science kit has every formula.

beats.title: Add anything
beats.vo: From the Add menu, bring in PDFs, slides, pictures and sticky notes.

beats.title: Web & camera
beats.vo: There's a safe web browser for research, and a document camera for showing real objects.

beats.title: Ask ZYNETIX AI
beats.vo: She asks ZYNETIX AI a question about the lesson.

beats.title: With sources
beats.vo: It answers at the class's level, and shows where it got the answer.

beats.title: AI lesson builder
beats.vo: Short on time? The lesson builder writes a whole lesson plan in seconds.

beats.title: A complete plan
beats.vo: Goals, steps, activities, and an exit ticket.

beats.title: More AI helpers
beats.vo: It can make a quick quiz in seconds. It can write tonight's homework for the class. It can draft the lecture notes. Or it can read whatever is on the board.

beats.title: Attendance
beats.vo: Attendance takes seconds, and goes straight to the school office.

beats.title: Ask the class
beats.vo: Now she asks the whole class a question.

beats.title: Answers from phones
beats.vo: Students answer on their phones, and the bars move live.

beats.title: Or answer cards
beats.vo: No phones? They hold up answer cards, and the camera reads them.

beats.title: Reveal the answer
beats.vo: Then she reveals the right answer.

beats.title: Word cloud
beats.vo: Or she asks for one word, and watches a word cloud grow.

beats.title: Classroom toolkit
beats.vo: Pick a random student to answer. Set a timer for the next group activity. Keep score in a team quiz. And give badges for great answers.

beats.title: Groups & zones
beats.vo: Make groups in a single tap. Or split the board, so students can write together.

beats.title: Homework AI
beats.vo: Homework AI turns today's lesson into homework.

beats.title: Sent to every student
beats.vo: One tap sends it to every student's app.

beats.title: Peer review & AI marks
beats.vo: Classmates review each other's work, and AI suggests marks for the teacher to approve.

beats.title: Course outcomes
beats.vo: Each question is tagged with a course outcome, for the college's records.

beats.title: Record the lesson
beats.vo: She presses record, and the board shows a consent notice first.

beats.title: Mark the moments
beats.vo: She adds chapter markers, and stars the important moments.

beats.title: Ready to share
beats.vo: Recordings come with a transcript and a summary, ready to share.

beats.title: Captions, cast & more
beats.vo: Live captions help everyone follow along. Students can cast their phone screens. The board can mirror to a second display at the back. And freeze screen pauses the picture.

beats.title: Eye comfort
beats.vo: Eye comfort makes the screen warmer and easier on the eyes.

beats.title: Dark mode
beats.vo: Or switch the whole board to dark.

beats.title: Three languages
beats.vo: The board speaks Hindi, and Kannada, as well as English.

beats.title: Help every learner
beats.vo: Voice commands work hands free. A reader reads the page aloud. A screen shade hides what's coming next. And a spotlight focuses attention.

beats.title: Magnifier
beats.vo: And a magnifier, for the tiniest details.

beats.title: Simple mode
beats.vo: In settings, simple mode gives big, easy buttons.

beats.title: Your own toolbar
beats.vo: Each teacher can arrange her own toolbar.

beats.title: Locked down, checked up
beats.vo: Touch lock keeps the board safe. And diagnostics report its health.

beats.title: Works offline
beats.vo: If the Wi-Fi drops, nothing is lost. Changes wait, and sync when it's back.

beats.title: End the class
beats.vo: When the bell rings, she ends the class.

beats.title: Everything in sync
beats.vo: Attendance, homework and recordings flow to the school's system, and to the teacher, student and parent apps.
One board for the whole lesson. Ink that feels real. A helpful AI assistant for every lesson. Live answers from every student. And every app in sync.
ZYNETIX Board. Every lesson, connected.
